headline: Oil Prices Decline as Gulf Exports Offset Middle East Supply Concerns
summary: Crude oil prices moved lower as robust export volumes from the Gulf offset risks associated with escalation in Iran and persistent supply glut concerns.
why: Crude oil is a critical global macroeconomic commodity whose price impacts energy sector earnings, inflation rates, and transport costs worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Oil prices declined as rising exports from the Gulf counterbalanced geopolitical escalation in the Middle East.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Crude oil fell because strong export shipments from Gulf producers outweighed geopolitical risks in Iran.
